summary: Static code review only (no servers started). Verified (A) theme toggle CSS fix in both admin & web globals.css and (B) new read-only Operations Dashboard page + admin nav link. Live click toggling not verified (no runtime).

evidence.admin_globals_css: :root --background:0 0% 100% (L15), --foreground:211 59% 8% (L16); .dark --background:211 59% 8% (L37), --foreground:0 0% 100% (L38). Blocks differ — light vs dark palette now distinct.
evidence.web_globals_css: Same pattern: :root L15 white bg / L16 dark fg vs .dark L38 dark bg / L39 white fg. Blocks differ.
evidence.shared_brand: Both files preserve --primary: 112 45% 50% (#56B947) L21/L43 and --accent: 155 77% 43% (#19C37D) L27/L49 in BOTH :root and .dark — brand green intact across themes.
evidence.theme_toggle_admin: setTheme(theme === 'dark' ? 'light' : 'dark') at theme-toggle.tsx L9. Web equivalent present.
evidence.layout_defaults: apps/admin/src/app/layout.tsx L18 and apps/web/src/app/layout.tsx L18 both use attribute="class" defaultTheme="dark" enableSystem.
evidence.tailwind: apps/admin/tailwind.config.ts L4 and apps/web/tailwind.config.ts L4 both darkMode: 'class'.
evidence.branding_preserved: Candila logo (/candila-fintech-logo.webp) and 'Candila TradeSync' title present in metadata + sidebar (dashboard/layout.tsx L55-59, footer '© 2026 Candila FinTech' L83-84).

operations_dashboard.read_only: Only GETs used via api.admin.masterAccounts.list, followers.list, executionHistory.summary/list, manualTrading.recent (page.tsx L109-115). No POST/PUT/DELETE/PATCH in the file. No backend files modified.
operations_dashboard.broker_health: ops-broker-health panel present with statusBadge() mapping CONNECTED→Connected (green), DISCONNECTED→Disconnected (slate), EXPIRED→Session Expired (amber), ERROR→Authentication Failed (red) — page.tsx L48-54.
operations_dashboard.order_monitor: ops-order-monitor table with columns Broker/Order ID/Symbol/Side/Qty/Status/Time (L220-229).
operations_dashboard.no_data_rule: num() and fmtTime() return 'No Data' for null/undefined/invalid (L33-44); empty arrays render 'No Data' row in all 3 tables (L192, L235, L281).
operations_dashboard.resilience: Uses Promise.allSettled with per-source null on rejection (L109-120); global error only when all 5 rejected (L121-123).
operations_dashboard.nav_link: apps/admin/src/app/dashboard/layout.tsx L13 adds { href:'/dashboard/operations', label:'Operations', icon: Activity } — placed 2nd in NAV list.

no_regression.notes: Verified admin api.ts already contained masterAccounts.list, followers.list, executionHistory.summary/list, manualTrading.recent (no additions). No apps/api / DB schema / shared contract changes required by this sprint. Changes limited to 4 files: apps/admin/src/app/globals.css, apps/web/src/app/globals.css, apps/admin/src/app/dashboard/operations/page.tsx (new), apps/admin/src/app/dashboard/layout.tsx (nav entry).

verification_results.typecheck_build: Not executed by this sub-agent (static review only). Main agent reported pnpm -r typecheck and pnpm -r build PASS — trusted; no obvious TS issues in the new page (imports resolve to existing types ExecutionHistoryRow, ExecutionHistorySummary, ManualTradeRecord, FollowerDto, TradingAccountDto, ConnectionStatus).
verification_results.live_toggle_click: PENDING — cannot verify runtime class switch without starting Next.js; recommend manual/e2e follow-up once servers are up.

critical_code_review_comments: Minor: 'Last Error' and 'API Response Time' columns in Broker Health are hard-coded to 'No Data' (page.tsx L200-201). Fine for Phase 1 per spec, but consider surfacing lastError/latency once available on TradingAccountDto.

Minor: executionHistory.list is called with sort:'timestamp:desc' — ensure the backend accepts this sort key (not part of ExecutionHistoryListQuery type shown here); harmless if ignored, but worth confirming to avoid 400s.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Once runtime available, click ThemeToggle in both admin (/dashboard) and web portals to confirm .dark class removal switches to light palette (white bg, dark fg). Then navigate to /dashboard/operations, verify all 8 ops-card-* testids, ops-broker-health, ops-order-monitor, ops-copy-monitor render, and empty states show 'No Data'.
